title: Italy Aerial Orthophoto (AGEA 2022–2024)
description: A seamless, country-wide mosaic of the Italian national orthophotos produced by AGEA (Agenzia per le Erogazioni in Agricoltura), re-published by MindEarth as a cloud-native, sharded Zarr v3 store. Built from AGEA's Web Mercator WMTS tile services (zoom 18, about 40–48 cm/px on the ground) for the 2022, 2023 and 2024 flights, priority-mosaicked so that 2024 wins wherever it has data, then 2023, then 2022. Stored as uint8 RGBA at 0.597 m/pixel in EPSG:3857, with alpha = 0 marking no-data. Basilicata is only available at about 180 cm/px and is upsampled ×4. The mosaic is not radiometrically balanced, so seams between flight years are expected.

zarr.title: Italy aerial orthophoto mosaic (Zarr v3, multiscale)
zarr.description: Sharded Zarr v3 store with consolidated metadata. Group '0' is native resolution (array 'rgba', shape 4 × 2899968 × 2244608, inner chunks 4×1024×1024, shards 4×16384×16384, zstd); groups '1'… are 2× overviews. The HTTP proxy does not list directories: open it as an anonymous S3 store (bucket 'mindearth', prefix 'italy-aerial/italy-aerial.zarr', endpoint https://data.source.coop, region eu-central-1, path-style requests).
